I don't think you'll find anything exactly like that. I think your options are going to be:

  • Use a website that lets you choose a base-model and upgrade via their system to a better card they offer.
  • Buy a kit from somewhere that may not include a video card, then buy that separately. You'd still need to put it all together but you wouldn't have to research the parts I suppose.
  • Buy a stock PC that only has an integrated GPU and add one.

Man, good luck and let us know if you find one. A $300 video card is probably going to have a heftier power draw than what a $400, off-the-shelf desktop is going to have. You'll likely at least need to replace that.

And at $400, don't think you'd get a decent SSD (either capacity or performance would take a small hit).

You really don't need any space to assemble a PC, if you have a desk where your current one is, that's all the space that's required.

Maybe hit up one of the guides at PC Part Picker.
